skins.name: River Spirit Nami
skins.description: Once upon a time, a young farmer was enchanted by music coming from the deep jungle, and followed it to the grove of a river spirit. Overcome by her beauty, he went to embrace her—and was dragged screaming into the emerald waters below, never to be seen again.

skins.description: An aquatic search and rescue med-bot whose manufacturer was acquired in an aggressive corporate takeover, Nami has been irreversibly changed by the directives of Program. For now, she continues in her primary function… though her behavior has become increasingly erratic.

skins.description: Nami's ambition to control the waves led to a destructive battle between her and god-emperor Jarvan IV, causing a great calamity to befall the world. But when the world faces an even greater threat—human nature at its most devious—Nami must swallow her pride and work with her former enemies to stop their story from being rewritten.

passive.name: Surging Tides
passive.description: When Nami's Abilities hit allied champions they gain Move Speed for a short duration.

spells.name: Aqua Prison
spells.description: Sends a bubble to a target area, dealing damage and stunning all enemies on impact.
spells.dynamicDescription: Sends a bubble towards a targeted area, dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamageTT@ magic damage</magicDamage> to enemies, and stunning them for @StunDuration@ seconds@SpellModifierDescriptionAppend@

spells.name: Ebb and Flow
spells.description: Unleashes a stream of water that bounces back and forth between allies and enemies, healing allies and damaging enemies.
spells.dynamicDescription:
Unleashes a stream of water that bounces back and forth between allies and enemies.

On Ally Hit: Heals @TotalHeal@ health and will bounce to a nearby enemy champion.

On Enemy Hit: Deals @TotalDamage@ magic damage and bounces to a nearby allied champion.

Bounces to each target only once, and hits up to @MaxTargets@ targets. The damage is reduced by @BounceScaling*100@% and the healing is reduced by @HealBounceScaling*100@% each bounce.@SpellModifierDescriptionAppend@

spells.name: Tidecaller's Blessing
spells.description: Empowers an allied champion for a short duration. The ally's basic attacks and spells deal bonus magic damage and slow the target.
spells.dynamicDescription: Empowers an allied champion for @BuffDuration@ seconds or @HitCount@ basic attacks. The ally's basic attacks deal <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ bonus magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>Slow</status> the target by @BaseSlow*100@% for @SlowDuration@ second.@SpellModifierDescriptionAppend@

spells.name: Tidal Wave
spells.description: Summons a massive Tidal Wave that knocks up, slows, and damages enemies.
spells.dynamicDescription:
Summons a Tidal Wave from Nami's position.

The Tidal Wave Knocks Up enemies and Slows them by @SlowAmount*100@%, dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage. The duration of the Slow increases based on how far the Tidal Wave has traveled, with a minimum duration of @MinSlowDuration@ seconds and a maximum of @MaxSlowDuration@ seconds.@SpellModifierDescriptionAppend@
